description: Spanish company acts from the official BORME gazette (Registro Mercantil, section A) by hoja registral, the register key (e.g. VI-23141) returned by search_european_companies for Spain: incorporations, officer appointments and dismissals (role + name), capital changes, mergers, dissolutions, insolvency. Daily flow since 2009, newest first (100 max + total count). Spanish personal IDs (DNI/NIE) and natural-person sole-shareholder names are redacted at ingestion, marked « […] ». The hoja of a sole trader (a BORME empresario individual act) returns 404, not billed; so does a hoja whose name carries no company legal form from the closed Spanish list (forme_juridique_non_servie: the name may be a sole trader's civil name). A company with a current name under objection (GDPR art. 21) returns the same 404 as an unknown hoja, not billed; an act's denomination under objection is served null and counted in ecartes.opposition (item kept, block partial in provenance). Basado en datos de la Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

hoja.description: Hoja registral (register-sheet key), e.g. VI-23141, from search_european_companies with pays=ES. The BORME does not publish the NIF.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_spanish_company_acts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
